title: {Syn} Quadratic Reciprocity Is a Hidden Symmetry
content:
Quadratic reciprocity explains when one odd prime is a square modulo another odd prime. Gauss called it the golden theorem and gave several proofs during his career.

The result is a prototype for reciprocity laws across modern number theory, including the much broader patterns studied in class field theory.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
